Name: Weather Totem
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod replaces the vanilla rain totem with a weather totem that displays a dialogue letting you choose which weather you want to call down from the heavens.

[list]
[*]Cloudy (as far as I can tell this is the weather that causes leaves to fall)
[*]Rain (rain without the chance of lightning)
[*]Thunder Storm (rain with lightning)
[*]Sunny
[*]Snow (I think cloudy will cause snow to fall in the winter as well, but this causes snow to fall any season)

[/list]

Each type of weather plays a custom sound when using the totem, that can be changed in the config.


[b][size=5]Translation[/size][/b]

The mod uses the SMAPI translation system, so please send me your json translation files and I can add it to the mod.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
